title: The Alloy of Law
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: Set centuries after the original Mistborn trilogy, in a city of trains, guns and electric lights, a lawman turned nobleman is pulled back into trouble. A hunt for criminals blends old-West style shootouts with the series' metal-based magic.
readIf: you want a quick, banter-heavy fantasy with gunfights, clever magic and a buddy dynamic.
skipIf: you want an epic like the original trilogy, since this is smaller, lighter and more of a caper.

pairings.reason: A similar mix of banter, clever plans and a city-based crew of charming rogues.
Also blends magic with detective-style investigation in a city, in a punchier, wisecracking way.
Another fantasy city with a bumbling lawman, though comic and satirical in tone.
